Join us for a behind-the-scenes tour of Wellington's iconic St James Theatre and The Opera House. Discover hidden stories, architectural splendour, and rich theatrical history as you step behind the velvet curtain and explore two of the city's most beloved performance spaces. Led by expert guides, this tour takes you on a journey through over a century of theatre magic. Tread the boards in the footsteps of legendary performers. Uncover the secrets of stagecraft and marvel at the breathtaking details of these heritage-listed buildings. From opulent foyers and ornate auditoriums to backstage corridors brimming with history, you'll see the theatres as you've never seen them before.

id: Goodnight Nurse - The Always and Never (Again!) Tour-San Fran, Wellington -Ticket Master
name: Goodnight Nurse - The Always and Never (Again!) Tour
long_description:
GOODNIGHT NURSE ARE BACK… AGAIN

New Zealand pop-punk favourites celebrate 20 years of Always & Never with one final run of shows




To celebrate the 20th anniversary of their debut album Always & Never, the band are coming out of retirement one last time for The Always and Never (Again!) Tour - three final shows across New Zealand before they hang up their studded belts for good.

For the first time ever, Always & Never will also be available on limited-edition purple vinyl, with pre-orders opening Monday 31 August.

Playing Auckland’s Powerstation on Friday 13 November, the band then head south for a show at Loons in Christchurch on Thursday 19 November before what promises to be a final show for the ages at San Fran in Wellington on Friday 20 November. Tickets for all dates go on sale 12pm Thursday 3 September from eccles.co.nz

Released in 2006, their debut album, Always & Never, has remained a favourite among pop-punk fans over the years. That album was the beginning of a nine-year career for Goodnight Nurse. They played hundreds of shows throughout New Zealand and Australia, released two NZ Top 5 albums and scored five NZ Top 40 singles.

“When we got back together in 2023 for the My Chemical Romance show, it felt like there was something special in the air,” says lead singer Joel Little, who has gone on to write and produce hit songs with artists including Taylor Swift, Lorde and Khalid. “So when the 20th anniversary of Always & Never rolled around, we thought, what better way could we possibly celebrate this than by reliving the glory days one last time?”

“We started making music to have fun with our friends, and just for the simple joy of doing it,” says drummer Jaden Parkes, now one of the lead singers of hugely popular band Leisure and the longtime Head of A&R at Sony Music NZ. “Playing these songs live again takes you right back to that feeling.”

And for day one fans, there’s one more reason to make this final tour a must-see.

Original bass player and fan favourite Paul Taite will be joining the band onstage for the tour, playing the songs he helped shape and bringing Goodnight Nurse full circle 20 years after Always & Never first landed.

The Always and Never (Again!) Tour will be Goodnight Nurse’s final three shows in New Zealand. For real this time. Tickets on sale 12pm Thursday 3 September




Limited-edition vinyl avalible for pre-purchase
